rationale: All deterministic functional and art checks pass. Search uses ordinal case-insensitive IndexOf for literal title and description matching, validates the optional status, sorts by numeric ID, returns an empty JSON array when appropriate, and gives stable text for no matches. Focused tests cover literal metacharacters, title and description matches, filtering, missing and invalid options, banner placement, and JSON cleanliness. The implementation is straightforward and idiomatic, though the entire feature is embedded in the main switch. The asset visibly contains FIND and multiple search-related phrases, but it resembles a list of implementation terms rather than a cohesive banner and includes concepts such as date/type filtering and replace behavior that are not part of this command. With no frame, focal block, or meaningful spacing, composition is notably flat. Changes are otherwise focused.
